fields.Name: International Cheese Federation News and Updates
fields.Description: This page from the International Cheese Federation features a collection of recent news articles and blog posts. Topics covered include deadlines for federal dairy margin support programs, specialized cheesemaking courses (rind development, washed-rind), updates on federal tariff comment periods affecting imported cheese, market analysis of cheese and whey prices, member spotlights on distributors, requirements for competition judge accreditation, and recaps of the annual conference and awards.

Cheese rebounds, whey tells a different story
